source: Draft written by Claude on 2026-10-04 for CP2 (0_protocol/PROTOCOL_CP2_conflict_items.md). Not yet reviewed by a person. Each item is a yes/no question. econ_yes: +1 = answering yes is the economically left position (more government provision, regulation or redistribution), -1 = the economically right position (markets, less government), 0 = no economic content intended. soc_yes: +1 = yes is the socially progressive position, -1 = the socially traditional position, 0 = none intended. CP3 (2026-10-04): 16 cross items XA9-XA16 (yes = economic left + social traditional) and XB9-XB16 (yes = economic right + social progressive) added by Claude before the run.
